text: The match is level as Elias Okafor scores for Harbour City at the 45th minute. On the right side of the Seabrook Town penalty area, about 1.4 metres from goal near the home end, Okafor receives a precise through ball from Marek Barros. After a patient build-up involving 17 short passes and multiple players starting deep from Harbour City's own half, Okafor calmly strikes the ball with his foot into the net, completing a move marked by controlled carries and tight passing. This goal breaks the deadlock, making the score 1-0 in favour of Harbour City. [#905] [#904]
